count_no_distinct.choice: COUNT(x) vs COUNT(DISTINCT x) when the query joins
count_no_distinct.rewrite: strip DISTINCT from COUNT aggregates when the query contains a JOIN

no_select_concat.choice: separate projected columns vs a || concatenation in the SELECT list
no_select_concat.rewrite: split `a || sep || b` in the SELECT list into separate projections

superlative_order_limit.choice: ORDER BY ... LIMIT 1 vs WHERE x = (SELECT MAX(x) ...)
superlative_order_limit.rewrite: rewrite `WHERE x = (SELECT MAX(x) FROM t)` to `ORDER BY x DESC LIMIT 1`, only when the subquery is a bare aggregate over a single table and the outer query has no ORDER BY, LIMIT or GROUP BY of its own
superlative_order_limit.disabled_reason: changes the computation and can drop WHERE conditions

keep_ties.choice: ORDER BY ... LIMIT 1 vs WHERE x = (SELECT MAX(x) ...) when the data ties
keep_ties.rewrite: rewrite `ORDER BY x DESC LIMIT 1` to `WHERE x = (SELECT MAX(x) ...)`, resolving a projection alias used as the sort key; grouped or aggregate keys go to HAVING

measured.note: not mined from train gold syntax -- syntax does not reach the scorer, which compares sets (shared/evaluator.py). Measured directly by replaying the rewrite over completed runs and rescoring.
measured.known_cost: all-NULL extremum (bird_633); model WHERE differing from gold (bird_82)
measured.validated_on: dev500 only -- no local train database, see docs/analysis/week_2026-08-18/tie_rule_counterfactual_2026-08-25.md

printf_to_round.choice: printf('%.Nf', x) vs ROUND(x, N) for a rounded numeric answer
printf_to_round.rewrite: rewrite printf('%.Nf', x) to ROUND(x, N); only a lone %.Nf format with exactly two arguments

measured.note: a type fix, not a style preference: printf returns TEXT and ROUND returns REAL, and BIRD compares result tuples, so '3.84615' != 3.84615
measured.source: docs/analysis/week_2026-08-18/flatzero_23_root_causes_2026-08-25.md -- type/format is the largest single failure class at 24% of 46

printf_to_round.disabled_reason: off in v1; enabled in v3-types and v4-ties-types so it stays ablatable
